seo.title: About | From managing 1,400 people to Henley-certified executive coaching
seo.description: An executive coach with 15 years of senior management experience in electronics manufacturing, scientifically trained by a top business school. Decisive, warm, and strategic.

hero.title: From Managing 1,400 People to Protecting a New Life
intro: In November 2021, the birth of my daughter changed my perspective on the world. To reunite with my family in the UK, I chose to leave the VP of Operations position I had cultivated for years. This was more than a geographical relocation; it was a profound transformation of values and identity.

This decision allowed me to transition from an operational leader to a professional coach. I understand the weight of 'starting over' when you have so much to lose, and the courage it takes to align your professional success with your personal mission.

sections.title: A Trajectory of Pragmatic Evolution
sections.lead: I didn't start in the boardroom. My journey from the factory floor to executive leadership gives me a 360-degree view of how organisations actually move.

items.title: Global Business Development
items.body: Leveraging my BSc in Electronics Engineering, I started as a Global BDM—bridging the gap between technical specs and commercial realities in international markets.

items.title: From Team Leader to Factory Ops
items.body: Moved into leadership roles, managing sales teams and eventually overseeing high-precision factory operations in Taiwan and Mainland China.

items.title: VP of Operations
items.body: Reached the level of VP of Operations, leading a multinational workforce of 1,400 people. This role taught me how to govern complex systems while holding space for human resilience.

cards.title: Multicultural Context Translation
body: I move fluently between English and Chinese thinking. I don't just translate words; I translate the cultural context, the unsaid expectations, and the business logic between the East and the West.

cards.title: Global Management at Scale
body: With experience leading 1,400 people across Mainland China, Taiwan, and the UK, I understand the friction of P&L, workforce volatility, and the reality of high-pressure operations.

cards.title: Cultivating Resilience
body: I help leaders transform their past management experience into coaching wisdom—building teams that are not just efficient, but sustainable and resilient.

left.title: The Henley Seal
body: In October 2024, I officially earned the Professional Executive Coaching Certification (PECE) from Henley Business School, University of Reading.
This rigorous scientific training allows me to combine field-hardened management experience with world-class coaching psychology.

right.title: The SustainSage Identity
body: I am an executive coach who understands your situation because I have been there.
I support senior executives, mid-career professionals, and high-potential graduates who are looking for more than just career advice—they are looking for strategic alignment.

cta.title: Ready for a Strategic Conversation?
cta.body: Let's map out your transition with the precision of an operator and the insight of a coach.
